titulo: Middle East Live: Several killed in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon
cuerpo: At ⁠least ​11 ​people were killed, including two infants, were injured ⁠in Israeli strikes on ​a ‌residential building in ‌a town ​in southern Lebanon early on Monday, ​Lebanon's ​state ​news agency ​reported.
